'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Kevin Shannon LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Shannon
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
